Sameer's farewell dinner was at a loud rooftop restaurant, with rain drumming on the tarpaulin, and Rafiq was on fire. He did impressions of their old professor, roasted everyone's outfits, kept the table howling. Vinita watched him. When someone asked, "Rafiq, how's your dad after the surgery?" he said, "Better than my love life!" and everyone laughed. When someone asked about his job hunt, he mimed a man drowning. Rafiq took a long breath. "Scary," he said.
